source.dataset: CMS Doctors and Clinicians: Facility Affiliation Data joined to the National Downloadable File, Medicare by-provider-and-service and NPPES

facility_affiliation.dataset: CMS Provider Data Catalog: Facility Affiliation Data

national_downloadable_file.dataset: CMS Provider Data Catalog: National Downloadable File
national_downloadable_file.filter: NPI in the hospital's Facility Affiliation rows; first row per NPI; columns Cred, Grd_yr, pri_spec, sec_spec_all

medicare_by_provider_and_service.dataset: CMS Medicare Physician & Other Practitioners - by Provider and Service, calendar year 2024
medicare_by_provider_and_service.filter: HCPCS_Cd in ['99281', '99282', '99283', '99284', '99285', '99291'] and Place_Of_Srvc == 'F', summed over codes per Rndrng_NPI; then NPI in the hospital's roster
medicare_by_provider_and_service.note: Original Medicare (fee-for-service) Part B only; rows with 10 or fewer beneficiaries are suppressed by CMS.

nppes.dataset: CMS NPPES (National Plan and Provider Enumeration System) monthly data dissemination file
nppes.filter: Entity Type Code == 1 (individuals); taxonomy code and primary-taxonomy switch columns 1-15; then NPI in the hospital's roster

nucc_taxonomy.dataset: NUCC Health Care Provider Taxonomy code set, version 25.1

definitions.em_physicians: pri_spec == 'EMERGENCY MEDICINE' in the National Downloadable File
definitions.em_apps: pri_spec in ['NURSE PRACTITIONER', 'PHYSICIAN ASSISTANT'] and at least 11 emergency-department visit services (HCPCS 99281-99285, place of service facility) billed under the clinician's own NPI to original Medicare in 2024. A LOWER BOUND: visits billed under a supervising physician, Medicare Advantage / commercial / Medicaid visits and suppressed rows (10 or fewer beneficiaries) are not visible.
definitions.physicians_total: pri_spec present and not one of the non-physician specialties ANESTHESIOLOGY ASSISTANT, AUDIOLOGIST, CERTIFIED CLINICAL NURSE SPECIALIST (CNS), CERTIFIED NURSE MIDWIFE (CNM), CERTIFIED REGISTERED NURSE ANESTHETIST (CRNA), CHIROPRACTIC, CLINICAL PSYCHOLOGIST, CLINICAL SOCIAL WORKER, DENTIST, MARRIAGE AND FAMILY THERAPIST, MAXILLOFACIAL SURGERY, MENTAL HEALTH COUNSELOR, NURSE PRACTITIONER, OCCUPATIONAL THERAPIST IN PRIVATE PRACTICE, OCCUPATIONAL THERAPY, OPTOMETRY, ORAL SURGERY, PHYSICAL THERAPIST IN PRIVATE PRACTICE, PHYSICAL THERAPY, PHYSICIAN ASSISTANT, PODIATRY, QUALIFIED AUDIOLOGIST, QUALIFIED SPEECH LANGUAGE PATHOLOGIST, REGISTERED DIETITIAN OR NUTRITION PROFESSIONAL, SPEECH LANGUAGE PATHOLOGIST
definitions.n_hospitals: number of distinct hospital certification numbers the NPI is affiliated with in the Facility Affiliation file
definitions.ed_visit_services: services, not patients and not hours; billed anywhere in the country, not necessarily at this hospital

not_covered: Residents and fellows: not enrolled as Medicare billing clinicians. Use the cost report's intern and resident FTE (hcris.json).
Nurses, technicians and all other employed staff: use registered-nurse FTE from the Provider of Services file and total FTE from the cost report.
Clinicians not enrolled in Medicare, or without enough recent Medicare claims at this hospital for CMS to affiliate them.
Hours worked: affiliation says a clinician practises at the hospital, not how much or in which department. 1038 of 2104 clinicians are affiliated with other hospitals as well.
